experiences.organization: FTI CUP 2025 Committee – Faculty of Industrial Engineering, UPN “Veteran” Yogyakarta
experiences.description: Equipment Division staff for the FTI CUP 2025 committee, a sports and e-sports competition for students of the Faculty of Industrial Engineering. The competition opened and ran on 14 and 27 September 2025.
responsibilities: Prepared and met the equipment needs that supported the preparation and smooth running of FTI CUP 2025.
Recorded, checked and managed the equipment inventory to make sure items were available and ready before the event started.
Responsible for distributing and setting up equipment according to technical needs during the competition.
Managed the collection and return of equipment after the event and made sure the items used were stored properly.

experiences.organization: Student Executive Board of the Faculty of Industrial Engineering (BEM FTI), UPN “Veteran” Yogyakarta
responsibilities: Contributed to the preparation and running of the FTI CUP 2025 matches in sports and e-sports, to help the event run smoothly.
Supported the technical coordination of the event and adjusted the flow of activities to what was needed on the ground.
Helped make sure the activities ran according to the planned schedule and rundown.
Collaborated with committee members from other divisions to handle operational needs during the competition.
